summary.blocking_reason: Deployment blocked by: POL-RDS-001 on aws_db_instance.main; POL-SG-001 on aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule.debug_ssh; POL-SG-003 on aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule.debug_ssh

failed_policies.title: Database is not publicly accessible
failed_policies.message: Database is configured to receive a public IP address and be reachable from the internet.
failed_policies.remediation: Set publicly_accessible = false and place the database in private subnets.

failed_policies.title: No internet ingress to administrative or database ports
failed_policies.message: Ingress from the internet (0.0.0.0/0) allowed to 22 (SSH).
failed_policies.expected: no internet ingress to administrative or database ports
failed_policies.remediation: Remove the rule, use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager for administration, or restrict the source to a specific range.

failed_policies.title: Application servers reachable only through the load balancer
failed_policies.message: Application servers accept traffic from a source other than the load balancer.
failed_policies.remediation: Reference the load balancer security group as the only source.

external_advisories_sample.title: Ensure CloudWatch log groups retains logs for at least 1 year
Ensure that CloudWatch Log Group is encrypted by KMS
Ensure that RDS instances have performance insights enabled
Ensure all data stored in RDS is not publicly accessible
Ensure that enhanced monitoring is enabled for Amazon RDS instances
Ensure CloudTrail defines an SNS Topic
Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted at rest using KMS CMKs
Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 80
Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 22
Ensure S3 buckets should have event notifications enabled
